name: Iron-Juggernaut
description: Iron-Juggernaut is a colossus of naked metal, its surface a continent-spanning shield of iron-nickel ridged with mountains that rise forty kilometers into a star-flecked black sky. The thin atmosphere scatters almost nothing, so noon here is merely a brighter kind of night, and the terminator line cuts razor-sharp across the terrain. Impact basins the size of kingdoms pucker the wastelands between the ranges, their floors glazed by ancient heat.

Nothing moves unless the wind does, and even then it moves slowly under nearly three gravities, hissing along the canyons like sandpaper drawn across the world. The silence has weight; suit mics pick up only the creak of one's own harness and a low magnetic groan as the crust flexes. At dusk the day side radiates its stored warmth in long infrared waves that shimmer on every sensor.

The mining complex at Mount Ferric Vault was stripped and abandoned within a single decade, its shafts driven toward something at depth that the ledgers only call the Resonance. When storms strike the great central massif, seismographs register a pure tonal ring, like a bell struck once and never fully silenced. No survey has explained why a dead world keeps ringing.

Its veins of platinum and uranium make the Juggernaut the richest unclaimed mass in the sector, and prospectors keep arriving despite suits that fail fast under 2.9g. The satellite graveyard in polar orbit holds derelicts from three navies, all pointed inexplicably down at the massif. Whoever learns what the Resonance is will own more than a mine.
